def factor_correlation_synergy_trend_smoothed(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    price_roc = df_copy['close'].pct_change(20)
    volume_roc = df_copy['volume'].pct_change(20)
    corr = price_roc.rolling(30, min_periods=30).corr(volume_roc).fillna(0)
    # lightweight ewma smoothing from alpha-stability-2
    smooth_corr = corr.ewm(span=5, adjust=False).mean().clip(0, 1)
    short_trend = (df_copy['close'].rolling(10).mean() / df_copy['close'].rolling(40).mean() - 1)
    long_trend = (df_copy['close'].rolling(20).mean() / df_copy['close'].rolling(80).mean() - 1)
    factor = short_trend * smooth_corr + long_trend * (1 - smooth_corr)
    factor.name = 'factor_correlation_synergy_trend_smoothed'
    return factor
